_note: Phase E Burrows props (docs/PHASE_E_SPEC.md section 17). size_m = [x width, y depth, z height] in metres, Blender axes (Godot: x, z, y). Fronts face Blender -Y (Godot +Z). Origin on the ground at the footprint centre unless origin says centre. collision null = walk-through / decided by the code. Parts are separate mesh nodes with their origin at the pivot; markers are empty nodes. Glowing parts are plain bright faces (vertex colour).

extra_colours._note: sRGB colours used here that art/palette.json does not have yet

props.name: burrow_hollow
props.notes: The Old Hollow: a dark round hole (1.6 m across) going down between giant mossy roots, wooden steps down on the north (camp, +Y) side. North rim 0.4 m, south rim (camera side, -Y) under 0.9 m in the middle, root arches on the east and west up to 2.95 m, two amber lanterns. Parts (origin on the ground at the hole centre): `seal` = violet Gloom crystals and brambles plugging the hole (sink it: position y -1.2 and scale y 0.1, then hide); `eyes` = two violet glints on the seal's south face, origin at their midpoint (blink them while sealed); `glow` = the hole's inner rim band, bright amber (hide it while sealed, show it once open). Front -Y faces the camera/woods; the camp is +Y.

props.name: hollow_roots_a
props.notes: Giant mossy root snaking flat from the treeline toward the Old Hollow (dressing in the cleared notch, no collision). Runs along X: the thick end (+X) comes out of the ground at the treeline, the thin end (-X) points at the hollow.

props.name: hollow_roots_b
props.notes: Giant mossy root snaking flat from the treeline toward the Old Hollow (dressing in the cleared notch, no collision). Runs along X: the thick end (+X) comes out of the ground at the treeline, the thin end (-X) points at the hollow.

props.name: burrow_hole
props.notes: Dirt spawn hole (Grublings, the Amber Grub): mound rim round a dark hole, claw marks, clods. Walk-over, no collision.

props.name: burrow_spring
props.notes: Moonwell spring (r 1.1). Walkable: the glowing water surface is at z 0.07 and the front (-Y) has a low gap with two stepping stones where the cat wades in. Mossy stone rim, small teal glow mushrooms, lily pads. No collision.

props.name: boon_shrine
props.notes: Mossy standing stone with a glowing teal leaf rune on its flat front (-Y) face. Two stand in a spring room; the code fades the one not taken.

props.name: root_lift
props.notes: Vine-basket lift in a niche of giant roots, open to the front (-Y). Part `basket` (origin on the ground at the basket centre, z 0 to 0.56): raise it (position y up) to lift the cat out; the vine ropes from the root knot (z 2.4) stay. Collision is up to the code.

props.name: burrow_chest
props.notes: Root chest, front -Y. Part `lid` with its origin on the hinge (back top edge of the body); open it by rotating about its local X axis, about -100 degrees in Godot (rotation.x = deg_to_rad(-100)) lifts the front. Inside: glowing amber and gold.

props.name: gloom_seal
props.notes: Violet Gloom crystal cage that sits over burrow_chest (same origin; inner clearance 1.02 x 0.72 x 0.8 m). Hide or shatter it when the seal is broken.

props.name: burrow_chest_boss
props.notes: Boss chest, wrapped in glowing teal vines. Root chest, front -Y. Part `lid` with its origin on the hinge (back top edge of the body); open it by rotating about its local X axis, about -100 degrees in Godot (rotation.x = deg_to_rad(-100)) lifts the front. Inside: glowing amber and gold.

props.name: trap_thorns
props.notes: Thorn floor plate (r 0.85). Part `spikes` is modelled RAISED (fired, tips at 0.58 m), origin on the ground at the plate centre: at rest set its position y to -0.5 (the tips then sit in the dark holes), fire = tween to 0, hold 0.5 s, back to -0.5. Walk-over, no collision.

props.name: spore_vent
props.notes: Spore vent: an earth vent ringed by tiny teal glow mushrooms. Part `cap` = the puffball cap on the vent, origin at its base (z 0.04): squash it (scale y down) before a puff. No collision.

props.name: dew_bud
props.notes: Closed green bud on a short stem with a glowing dew drop inside. Part `petals` (origin at the top of the stem, z 0.2): open it by scaling (about x 1.7, y 0.45, z 1.7 in Godot) so the four petals splay out and show the dew. No collision.

props.name: glow_mushroom_big
props.notes: Tall glowing teal mushroom (Grotto dressing): pale stem, big teal cap with bright spots, two small ones at its foot.

props.name: amber_cluster
props.notes: Amber crystals on a dark rock (Deeps dressing; also the level-5 fallback cap). Origin on the ground at its centre.

props.name: root_tangle
props.notes: Floor and wall dressing: roots looping out of the ground. No collision.

props.name: mat_amber
props.notes: Pickup. Origin at its centre (floats and spins, like golden_leaf). Honey-orange amber resin crystal (double point) with a small side crystal.

props.name: mat_glowstone
props.notes: Pickup. Origin at its centre (floats and spins, like golden_leaf). Rounded teal glowstone pebble with bright faces (teal, never violet).

props.name: mat_heartwood
props.notes: Pickup. Origin at its centre (floats and spins, like golden_leaf). Knot of red-brown heartwood root looped round a glowing amber core; stands upright, face toward -Y.

props.name: dew_drop
props.notes: Pickup. Origin at its centre (floats and spins, like golden_leaf). Green water drop (heals 1).

props.name: barricade_heartwood
props.notes: Barricade level 5 (Heartwood): three carved heartwood logs with amber cores, four pointed posts, bound with glowing amber root bands; a carved amber leaf on the front. Runs 3.0 m along X, front -Y faces the woods, same footprint as the other barricades.

props.name: acorn_tower_5
props.notes: Level 5 acorn tower (the Amber Tower): heartwood frame on a stone and root footing, bound with glowing amber root bands, a crown of amber crystals round the deck (the amber cap). `turret` = the heartwood crossbow loaded with an amber acorn, origin on its vertical turning axis at the top of the fixed collar, aims -Y; rotate it about its local up axis. `marker_shoot` (child of turret) = bolt tip, where the acorn leaves. Front -Y.

props.name: thorn_spikes_5
props.notes: Level 5 spikes (Amber Thorns): a thorn bed of heartwood stakes with glowing amber tips and heartwood bramble vines with amber thorns. Ground trap (walk-over, no blocking), trap area about 1.3 x 1.0 m like thorn_spikes_1-3.
